name: White cabbage (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of White cabbage (Brassica oleracea L. var. capitata L. f. alba DC.) [Vegetables] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, MANUAL, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: Rosa et al. 2001, J Sci Food Agric, doi:10.1002/jsfa.919 (glucose/fructose/sucrose in white cabbage)
PMC7464038 Comparative Evaluation of Bioactive Compounds and Volatile Profile of White Cabbages (sugars, ascorbate, sinapic acid)
Fresh/fermenting white cabbage organic-acid study (ResearchGate fig tbl2 id 338031753; fresh total acidity ~0.4%, malic/citric predominant)
Oxalate-content reviews classifying cabbage as low-oxalate (<10 mg/100 g fw)
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources for growth: free glucose (~1.7 g) and fructose (~1.4 g), plus L-malic acid (~0.24 g) as the principal organic acid and a malolactic substrate; citric acid secondary. Nitrogen supplied largely by free glutamate/glutamine and a full amino-acid pool. Very low fat. Organic-acid amounts are literature midpoints (medium confidence); succinic/fumaric present but unquantified. FooDB noise (heavy metals, rare-earths, animal metabolites, predicted amines, gas placeholders) r
curation_added: L-malic acid (dominant organic acid, was absent)
succinic acid, fumaric acid (present but unquantified)
individual free sugars with amounts (glucose > fructose >> sucrose)
consolidated iron and removed organelle/oxidation-state duplicates

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all divides components by (components + unresolved ingredients). It counts pipeline-derived components as covered, so it is not a measure of how much of the source's own ingredient list was captured. pct_covered_source divides source-stated components by (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components), which is that measure. Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
